lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four primary horizontal rows along the lateral flank, with the highest-intensity centroids located posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows, forming a grid of high-luminance nodes most visible in the anterior region of the trunk.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a lower-intensity ventral shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration of smaller spots along the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin and irregular wear on the distal tip of the upper caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition from large, widely-spaced macro-blobs on the trunk to a high-density cluster of micro-spots on the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits.
